en.headline: KMB suspends driver after staff car hits two cyclists in Sai Kung
en.dek: A Kowloon Motor Bus field car crossed the line on Tai Mong Tsai Road on Sunday morning, injuring two men on bicycles; police classed the case as a traffic accident with injury.
body: Kowloon Motor Bus said it had immediately suspended a driver from driving duties after one of its field cars was involved in a collision with two bicycles on Tai Mong Tsai Road in Sai Kung on Sunday morning.

Police said the private car was travelling towards Pak Tam Chung at about 9.30am when it lost control near Cho Wo Shan Villa and struck two oncoming bicycles heading towards Sai Kung town. The riders, men aged 55 and 57, were taken to Prince of Wales Hospital and Tseung Kwan O Hospital. Both were conscious when they arrived.

Police classified the case as a traffic accident with injury and assigned it to the traffic accident investigation unit of Kowloon East. The company said it had sent staff to visit the injured cyclists and would cooperate with the police inquiry.
KMB confirmed the vehicle was a company field car rather than a franchised bus in passenger service. The driver remained at the scene to assist investigators.

zh.headline: 西貢九巴外勤車撞兩單車 司機被暫停駕駛職務
zh.dek: 九巴一輛外勤私家車周日早上在大網仔路越線，撞傷兩名騎單車男子；警方列交通意外有人受傷，九巴稱已暫停涉事司機駕駛職務。
body: 九巴表示，周日早上約九時半，該公司一輛外勤車輛沿西貢大網仔路往北潭涌方向行駛，至近早禾山莊對開與兩輛單車發生碰撞，公司已即時暫停該名駕駛員的駕駛職務。
警方指，私家車當時懷疑失控越線，撞向對面行車線兩輛正前往西貢市中心的單車。兩名分別55歲及57歲的男子受傷，分別送往沙田威爾斯親王醫院及將軍澳醫院，送院時清醒。
案件列作交通意外有人受傷，交由東九龍總區交通意外調查組跟進。九巴稱已派員慰問受傷的騎單車人士，並會配合警方調查。
九巴證實涉事車輛為外勤私家車，並非載客巴士。司機事後在場協助調查。
